This handbook is a recent, and still incomplete, attempt at writing down
practices for working in the group, covering the tools we use, how to get onto
the computing clusters and how we use AI tools. The pages are suggestions
rather than settled group conventions, and they are meant to be adapted as the
group tries them out. If something does not fit how you work, or something is
missing, please open an issue or suggest a change through the links at the
bottom of each page.
